dependency_determination.production_checkout_dependency: NONE in the tools: every path is relative to the checkout that contains the tool, so a staging worktree renders and checks its own docs/weekly_note.html. The only shared input is the live evidence store (read-only SELECT). No hardcoded production path exists, so no path change was made.
dependency_determination.what_remains_a_production_step: the note that ships and is deployed must be rendered at the freeze in the checkout that is frozen (7.0.1 pattern): its as_of is the generation time and the recount is live, so a note rendered earlier in staging is superseded by the freeze-day render and by any later evidence-store change (LIVE_RECHECK semantics: an input change between render and check legitimately fails strict equality)
dependency_determination.staging_inputs_may_lag_production: docs/evidence_changes/ and registry/ in the staging tree are the branch's committed copies (base main 696d871e + v8 commits); the production checkout's copies are refreshed by the nightly chain. The staged note therefore reports the branch's archive (47 filings) while its event counts come from the live store; the checker compares the note only with the live store and the same checkout's registry, so the check is self-consistent.
